data.notes: October 2026 is unusually strong for Dubai’s open-air electronic circuit, with Pacha ICONS, Bohemia, Ushuaïa Dubai Harbour, Soho Garden and Be Beach all anchoring the month alongside diaspora pop concerts.

events.title: Black Coffee at Ushuaïa Dubai Harbour Experience
events.summary: Black Coffee headlines the Season 3 opening party of Ushuaïa Dubai Harbour Experience. Platinumlist lists Black Coffee and Drive for the 24 October event at the Dubai Harbour venue.

events.title: Carl Cox | Season Opening – Pacha ICONS
events.summary: Carl Cox opens the new Pacha ICONS season at Playa Pacha, FIVE LUXE JBR. The official page bills the event as a season-opening night of house at Dubai’s open-air dancefloor.

events.title: Adam Port | Pacha ICONS
events.summary: Adam Port returns to Pacha ICONS at Playa Pacha, FIVE LUXE JBR. The official listing frames the night around the Keinemusik-linked artist’s deep, hypnotic house and Afro-influenced rhythms.

events.title: Sonny Fodera | Playa Pacha
events.summary: Sonny Fodera brings his house sound to Playa Pacha at FIVE LUXE JBR. The official Pacha ICONS page lists Sonny Fodera with TSHA and Molly D on the lineup.

events.title: Bohemia Presents Lost Frequencies | Season Opening Party
events.summary: Lost Frequencies headlines Bohemia Beach Club’s season opening party at FIVE Palm Jumeirah. The bill is positioned as a beachfront electronic-music opener for Bohemia’s autumn run.

events.title: Nancy Ajram Live
events.summary: Nancy Ajram performs a one-night Arabic pop concert at Coca-Cola Arena. The ticket page confirms the 24 October date and presents the show as the Queen of Arabic Pop’s return to Dubai.

events.title: I Hate Models at HIVE, Soho Garden Meydan
events.summary: I Hate Models headlines HIVE at Soho Garden Meydan on 24 October. The Platinumlist event page describes a high-intensity night of techno, industrial and trance-influenced sounds.

events.title: MASSANO at HIVE, Soho Garden Meydan
events.summary: Massano headlines HIVE at Soho Garden Meydan with support from SLVR and Jean B. Platinumlist frames the night around melodic house and techno, including Massano’s Afterlife/Drumcode-linked sound.

events.title: Bohemia Presents Robin Schulz
events.summary: Robin Schulz returns to Dubai for Bohemia Presents at Bohemia Beach Club, FIVE Palm Jumeirah. Visit Dubai lists the event for 10 October as part of Bohemia’s new season.

events.title: Bohemia Presents THEMBA
events.summary: South African electronic artist THEMBA headlines Bohemia Beach Club as part of the Bohemia Presents Saturday series. Ticketmaster lists the event for 17 October at 7pm at FIVE Palm.

events.title: INDO WAREHOUSE - Skyline Saturdays at The Penthouse
events.summary: Touring South Asian electronic/Indo-house brand Indo Warehouse lands at Skyline Saturdays with Kahani and Kunal Merchant blending club rhythms with South Asian folk and cinematic textures.

events.title: TJ Monterde & KZ Tandingan – In Between Middle East Tour
events.summary: Filipino artists TJ Monterde and KZ Tandingan bring their In Between Middle East Tour to Coca-Cola Arena. The event is billed as an OPM concert featuring the two charting Filipino performers.

events.title: Bohemia Presents Dennis Cruz
events.summary: Dennis Cruz headlines Bohemia Beach Club at FIVE Palm on 31 October. Ticketmaster lists the event for 7pm as part of the Bohemia Presents programme.

events.title: No Limit Fest Dubai: Ruger Live
events.summary: Afrobeats-forward diaspora festival debut at Helipad by Frozen Cherry, headlined by Ruger and billed around Afrobeats, Amapiano, hip-hop, electronic and Latin sounds.

events.title: Andrea Oliva at Be Beach Dubai
events.summary: Qabila presents Andrea Oliva at Be Beach Dubai with support from Alex Twin. The waterfront party leans into Oliva’s house and techno sound associated with Ibiza’s ANTS parties.

events.title: Falguni Pathak Live in Dubai
events.summary: Falguni Pathak returns to Dubai for a live music and dance event at Zabeel Park Amphitheatre. Platinumlist bills the show around her dandiya and garba repertoire.

events.title: Aquaventure After Dark
events.summary: Three-stage after-hours waterpark party pairing hip-hop, R&B and Afrobeats with house/EDM areas, including Taya Kruzz, Keza, Tom Higham, Scott Forshaw and a Fred’s Coffee Party takeover.

events.title: OpenHouse Outdoor Day Party
events.summary: OpenHouse returns as a Dubai open-air day-party takeover, gathering multiple local event brands, sounds and communities on one stage from 3pm till late.

events.title: Elrow Dubai 2026
events.summary: Platinumlist confirms elrow Dubai 2026 at Dubai Media City Amphitheatre on Saturday 24 October 2026, with doors at 16:00. The edition uses the Nowmads theme; DJ announcements are still pending on the source page.

events.title: elrow Dubai 2026: Nowmads
events.summary: The global elrow party brand returns to Dubai with its Nowmads theme, a one-day immersive electronic festival at Dubai Media City Amphitheatre with large-scale production and DJ lineup still to be announced.

events.title: Richard Marx Live at Coca-Cola Arena
events.summary: Coca-Cola Arena confirms Richard Marx for Saturday 3 October 2026 at 8:00 PM. The show is billed as his first Middle East performance, covering four decades of hits.

events.title: Blue 25th Anniversary Tour Dubai
events.venueName: Dubai Millennium Amphitheatre, Expo City Dubai
events.summary: Live Nation Middle East confirms Blue's 25th Anniversary Tour at Dubai Millennium Amphitheatre, Expo City Dubai, on Sunday 25 October 2026. The British pop group is billed for a hits-focused anniversary concert.

events.title: Boris Grebenshikov
events.summary: Ticketmaster UAE confirms Boris Grebenshikov at The Agenda on Saturday 24 October 2026 at 8:00 PM. The listing presents the Aquarium founder as performing in Dubai with BG+.

events.title: Summer in Nashville Dubai 2026
events.summary: The official Summer in Nashville site confirms the Dubai edition at Dubai Media City Amphitheatre on Saturday 31 October 2026. The event is billed as a touring country festival, with detailed artist billing not yet listed on the source page.

events.title: God Save the Queen - A Tribute in Dubai
events.summary: Platinumlist confirms the Queen tribute show at Dubai Opera on Monday 5 October 2026 at 8:30 PM. The event is presented by Star System and features the touring tribute act led by Pablo Padín.

events.title: KPOPZ Live - The Ultimate K-pop Experience
events.summary: Platinumlist confirms this K-pop tribute production at Theatre by QE2 on Saturday 3 October 2026. The show is built around K-pop choreography, immersive visuals and music associated with major Korean pop acts.
